```{r}
#| include: false
source("scripts/fig/Resultants.R")
PATH.curves <- Calculation$paths$shotcreteResultants
PATH.scales <- Calculation$paths$shotcreteScales
RADIUS <- Calculation$shotcrete$section$centroidalRadiusM
PLOT.N <- buildCalculationResultantsInteractive(
  pathCurves = PATH.curves,
  pathScales = PATH.scales,
  radius = RADIUS,
  graphicAmplification =
    Calculation$shotcrete$display$graphicAmplification,
  raysPerCircle = Calculation$shotcrete$display$raysPerCircle,
  resultant = "N",
  liningID = "shotcrete",
  scaleMode = "local-by-lining-and-resultant"
)
PLOT.M <- buildCalculationResultantsInteractive(
  pathCurves = PATH.curves,
  pathScales = PATH.scales,
  radius = RADIUS,
  graphicAmplification =
    Calculation$shotcrete$display$graphicAmplification,
  raysPerCircle = Calculation$shotcrete$display$raysPerCircle,
  resultant = "M",
  liningID = "shotcrete",
  scaleMode = "local-by-lining-and-resultant"
)
PLOT.Q <- buildCalculationResultantsInteractive(
  pathCurves = PATH.curves,
  pathScales = PATH.scales,
  radius = RADIUS,
  graphicAmplification =
    Calculation$shotcrete$display$graphicAmplification,
  raysPerCircle = Calculation$shotcrete$display$raysPerCircle,
  resultant = "Q",
  liningID = "shotcrete",
  scaleMode = "local-by-lining-and-resultant"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-resultants-shotcrete100-normal
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP.N
#| echo: false
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-align: center
PLOT.N
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-resultants-shotcrete100-moment
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP.M
#| echo: false
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-align: center
PLOT.M
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-resultants-shotcrete100-shear
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP.Q
#| echo: false
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-align: center
PLOT.Q
```


```{r}
#| include: false
rm(
  CAP.N, CAP.M, CAP.Q,
  PATH.curves, PATH.scales, RADIUS,
  PLOT.N, PLOT.M, PLOT.Q,
  buildCalculationResultantsInteractive
)
```
